# temps_custom_domain (Resource)

A custom hostname that routes to a project environment, or redirects to another URL.

Temps requests the TLS certificate once DNS points at the server; `status` shows progress. Domains are unique across the whole server, not only within a project.

Import with `<project_id>/<domain_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`, `projects:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_custom_domain" "app" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id = data.temps_environment.production.id
  domain         = "app.example.com"
}

# Send the bare domain to the app with a permanent redirect.
resource "temps_custom_domain" "apex" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id = data.temps_environment.production.id
  domain         = "example.com"
  redirect_to    = "https://app.example.com"
  status_code    = 308
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Hostname, lower case without a trailing dot, for example `app.example.com` or `*.preview.example.com`. Changes in place.
- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment the domain serves; it must belong to `project_id`. Changes in place.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) Git branch whose preview this domain serves.
- `redirect_to` (String) Redirect every request to this URL instead of serving the environment.
- `service_name` (String) Docker Compose service the domain routes to. Only meaningful for Docker Compose projects.
- `status_code` (Number) HTTP status of the redirect: 301, 302, 303, 307 or 308. Requires `redirect_to`. The API cannot clear it, so removing it replaces the domain.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric custom domain ID.
- `message` (String) Detail about the status, such as why a certificate failed.
- `status` (String) Certificate status, for example `pending` or `active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_custom_domain.app 3/12
```
